dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular closed and semi-closed loops of high-intensity pixels on a low-intensity background. The most prominent exhibit a light-to-dark gradient transition from the outer perimeter to the interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of asymmetrical, solid high-intensity pixel clusters localized primarily on the lower-mid lateral flank, lacking internal light gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of three primary macro-annuli on the upper mid-section form an obtuse triangle, while smaller blobs along the posterior form a linear-oblique chain.
